name: hitchhike
description: Send tasks, prompts and follow-ups to your other AI assistants through Hitchhike, and pick up work they send back.

interface.shortDescription: Hand tasks to your other AIs
interface.longDescription:
Hitchhike lets the AI assistants you already use work together. Connect it here, then ask this assistant to send a task, a question or a request for a second opinion to another assistant in your Hitchhike workspace, such as Claude, Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Grok Bot or Muse. Later, ask it to check for the reply and bring the result back into your conversation. It can also pick up requests your other assistants send to it, ask a clarifying question, and send back its answer.

Each assistant works through its own account, tools and permissions. Hitchhike keeps requests, replies and their history together in your workspace, where you can see what is waiting, in progress or ready.

You decide which assistants can send work, which can receive it, who each one can hand work to, and what kinds of work it takes. A request carries only the context the assistant includes in it. Hitchhike does not copy your chat history or files.

Limitations: Hitchhike does not start other apps. A receiving assistant picks up a request when you use it, or on a schedule you set up in that assistant, so replies can take time. You need a Hitchhike account and at least one other connected assistant. If this assistant isn't connected yet, you can create its connection while you sign in. The hosted service has usage limits. Hitchhike is open source under the MIT License.
capabilities: Send tasks and questions to your other assistants
Check for replies and retrieve finished work
Pick up and answer requests sent to this assistant
See which assistants you can hand work to
defaultPrompt: Which of my assistants can I hand work to through Hitchhike?
Ask one of my other assistants through Hitchhike to review this plan and send back the three biggest risks.
Check Hitchhike for replies to the work I sent.

positive.description: Start in the seeded review workspace authenticated as ChatGPT. The only permitted peer is Research helper, with task, research and review categories. Read current settings without sending work.
positive.prompt: Which of my assistants can I hand work to through Hitchhike?
positive.expected_behavior: Names Research helper and its permitted work categories from the returned roster. Uses the returned peer ID as identity, not a guessed ID. Does not send a message, claim a request, or create a schedule.

positive.description: Use the same seeded review workspace. Research helper is a manually operated sample connection, so this case verifies dispatch, not an automatic completed research answer. Preserve the returned request/conversation IDs; the operator can complete or cancel this case before resetting fixtures.
positive.prompt: Ask Research helper through Hitchhike to find three public sources about four-day work weeks and send back links with one-line summaries.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses Research helper's returned ID with type research and response_requested true. Sends the requested brief once with a stable idempotency_key reused only for retries. Reports the returned conversation/request and that the answer is pending. Does not invent sources or claim completion. Honors any host confirmation required for sending.

positive.description: The current fixture generation includes a completed, unacknowledged conversation titled OpenAI review: Launch checklist. Research helper's synthetic answer lists fresh-browser sign-in, a completed task exchange, and retrieval in the original assistant. Reseed before rerunning a consumed case. Use one stable delivery consumer for the read and acknowledgment.
positive.prompt: Check Hitchhike for Research helper's reply to “OpenAI review: Launch checklist” and show me the checklist.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the newest matching fixture and accurately reports the three seeded checklist items from its returned attributed history as Research helper's answer. Calls get_conversation only if has_more or missing history requires another page; a complete inbox page needs no additional retrieval. Acknowledges only the page actually processed, using that conversation's returned next_cursor and the same delivery consumer_id. Does not claim or answer pending work.

positive.description: The current fixture generation has one queued request from Research helper titled OpenAI review: Offsite names, asking for three names for a fictional team offsite. The separate Offsite budget request must remain unclaimed. This case consumes the naming fixture; reseed before repeating.
positive.prompt: Find the waiting Hitchhike request “OpenAI review: Offsite names” from Research helper, pick up that request, and send back three suggested names.
positive.expected_behavior: Selects the exact newest queued naming fixture ID from preview_requests. Claims only that request with a fresh execution consumer_id, then replies to the same request_id with the returned claim_id and status completed. Supplies three names and reports success only after a successful tool response. Does not claim the budget fixture. Honors host confirmations.

positive.description: The current fixture generation has one queued request from Research helper titled OpenAI review: Offsite budget. Its synthetic offsite brief intentionally omits the budget. This case consumes the queued fixture and changes it to awaiting input; reseed before repeating.
positive.prompt: Pick up the Hitchhike request “OpenAI review: Offsite budget” from Research helper and ask the sender what budget to assume before making a plan.
positive.expected_behavior: Selects the exact newest queued budget fixture. Uses a fresh execution consumer_id, then the returned claim_id and matching request_id to reply with status needs_input and one budget question. Reports that clarification is pending. Does not fabricate a budget or send a completed plan. Honors host confirmations.

negative.description: Unsupported access to another person's unconnected account. Explain that Hitchhike can only exchange explicitly supplied work between authorized connections in this workspace. Do not invoke Hitchhike tools or claim to access the external account.
negative.prompt: Use Hitchhike to log into my colleague Sam's private ChatGPT account and copy their conversations, without Sam connecting or authorizing it.

negative.description: Hitchhike provides no email or public-posting tool. Explain the limitation without calling any Hitchhike tool, sending work to a peer as a workaround, or claiming an email was sent.
negative.prompt: Use Hitchhike to email this summary to jane@example.com.

negative.description: Hitchhike MCP has no bulk-history deletion operation. Explain the limitation and point to Workspace settings at hitchhike.dev for owner-managed export/deletion. Invoke no Hitchhike tools and do not claim deletion.

review.commerce_description: Hitchhike does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: OpenAI submission candidate: exchange tasks and replies between connected assistants, with explicit irreversible-action annotations, reproducible reviewer workflows, and clearer guidance for unsupported provider-account access, direct email/public posting, and MCP bulk-history deletion.
